name: mimo-vision
description: Analyze local or remote images through Xiaomi MiMo Vision from DXT-compatible MCP clients.
long_description: MiMo Vision MCP gives text-only agents a lightweight image analysis tool. This legacy DXT manifest uses the older Desktop Extensions schema and a traditional Python server bundle for clients that do not support MCPB/uv yet.

tools.name: mimo_image_analyze
tools.description: Analyze an image using Xiaomi MiMo Vision. Supports local image file paths and http(s) URLs.

mimo_api_key.title: MiMo API Key
mimo_api_key.description: Your Xiaomi MiMo API key. It is injected at runtime as MIMO_API_KEY.
